title: Kicked Umami Portuguese Shrimp Stew
description: A low calorie, umami rich Portuguese stew featuring shrimp, shrimp paste, and kapi, cooked in a cataplana vessel to reduce and intensify flavors, perfect as a hangover cure.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the cataplana vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the shrimp paste and kapi, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the white wine, chicken broth, tomato paste, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the peeled and deveined shrimp, and cook until they are pink and fully cooked.
Use an immersion blender to aerate the stew and intensify the flavors.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro.
